Measured on the merged tree: tape-01 + tape-02 + c7-standing-order-replay 14/14 and same-laws-harvest-parity 4/4 (eventLogHash fnv1a32:a6c04f80 unchanged), test:node-guards 564 pass. The door and board changes live in functions/ and site/, which are outside the hash corpus. Same era: no view field was removed or renamed and no tape shape was invalidated.
